name: Banyan Tree Phuket
positioning: All-pool-villa resort set around a lagoon near Bang Tao Beach in Phuket, with a golf course on the estate and a strong spa and wellbeing focus
best_for: Couples who want a private pool villa
Golfers who want a course on the estate
Families wanting villas with kitchenettes and a kids club

facts.text: The villas are set around a lagoon across an 89-acre estate.
Bang Tao Beach is steps from the resort grounds.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the resort as designed as a Thai village and built on rehabilitated wasteland.
Laguna Golf Phuket, an 18-hole par-71 course, sits within the same estate.
The Banyan Pool Villa has traditional Thai design with a Japanese bed and an outdoor bathtub.
The two- and three-bedroom family pool villas have kitchenettes, separate living areas and Thai salas built for a private BBQ.
Terra Kids Club has both indoor and outdoor areas with activities for children.
DoublePool Villa guests get a daily herbal cuddle, such as herbal baths, herbal steams and herbal infusions.
Saffron, the signature restaurant, serves modern renditions of Thai classics.
The resort has three tennis courts.
The resort team offers a guided tour of Thalang to meet the local community.
Guests can explore the lagoons by paddle board, kayak or a 3-wheel water bicycle.

highlights.text: Every villa at Banyan Tree Phuket is a private pool villa.
The Wellbeing Centre houses Thailand's first White Room, a sensory-reduction space for meditation and breathwork.
The DoublePool Villas sit in a secluded corner of the estate, each with two pools.
Every spa treatment takes place in a private treatment villa.
Tin Tapas Bar is a floating tapas bar built over a former tin mine, for sundowners on the lagoon.

considerations.text: The resort is approximately 16 kilometers from Phuket International Airport.
WhataHotel notes the secluded location requires transportation to the main attractions.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
